gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Press Start 2P looks like cut-out letters pinned far apart, with big open bowls and strokes that only vary when you squint. Noto Sans Kaithi is the sturdier half, its lowercase filling the line like capitals.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Gentle and approachable, the body text rises only slightly from small letters to capitals, and its s curves open wide at both ends. Noto Sans Kannada simply reads smoothly, while Press Start 2P brings the retro, pinned-apart fun with its mild contrast.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Neutral and clean, Noto Sans Kayah Li lifts its brush ends away before each curve closes, and its capitals barely top the lowercase. And Press Start 2P, with a medium weight change along each stroke, adds the playful retro spark above it.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-kharosht: Heavy thick strokes with thin ones about half their weight give Press Start 2P its retro, fun character, spaced like cut-out letters. And Noto Sans Kharoshthi follows with curves that never close back on themselves, laying a dark, solid stripe of lowercase through every line.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Noto Sans Khmer has generous openings like a chisel notch in wood, and its small letters stand almost capital-sized. Its clean, modern feel is the quality that counts most.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Press Start 2P is fun and retro, with a g of lightly thinned links. Noto Sans Khojki does the quieter job, with exits wide enough to pass light through and a large, clear eye on every e.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-khudawad: Press Start 2P brings the retro fun, its thin strokes only slightly lighter than thick. Noto Sans Khudawadi handles the quiet work, keeping capitals close to body height and its rounds unsealed like an unlatched hook.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-lao: Press Start 2P is playful and retro, with big open bowls. Over a longer passage, Noto Sans Lao reads in a modern way, its x-height pushed well above the usual and its mouths staying open.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-lao-loop: Press Start 2P is the fun, retro one, with horizontals a notch lighter than its uprights. And Noto Sans Lao Looped does the steadier job, making words read as solid blocks rather than skylines.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu has tall-bodied small letters and curves that look like they are gaping, which feels contemporary and approachable. And over a longer passage, Press Start 2P above it keeps things retro, with moderate contrast that is neither stark nor flat.
